title: Accessible and professional
content:
Julia Engwell Clinic is always accessible both through telephone calls and when you walk into the centre even without appointment. 

The staff always act in a polite manner, every professional, full attention is given to patients and all concerns dealt with accordingly.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
